Snippet.title: Snippet
Snippet.description: Represents a Unity C# code snippet with its associated metadata.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Snippet entity.

title.description: The title of the code snippet.

description.description: A brief explanation of the code snippet's purpose.

code.description: The Unity C# code snippet itself.

tagIds.description: References to Tags. (Relationship: Tag N:N Snippet)

Tag.title: Tag
Tag.description: Represents a tag associated with code snippets.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Tag entity.

name.description: The name of the tag (e.g., Input, UI, AI, Gameplay).

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

displayName.description: The display name of the user.

avatarUrl.description: URL of the user's avatar image.

id.description: The slug of the bookmarked snippet, matching Snippet.slug

Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: Represents a comment on a code snippet.

authorId.description: The UID of the user who wrote the comment.

authorDisplayName.description: The display name of the user who wrote the comment.

authorAvatarUrl.description: The avatar URL of the user who wrote the comment.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the comment was created.

admin.description: Grants administrator privileges to the user.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile information. The 'userId' parameter matches the Firebase Authentication UID.

/users/{userId}/bookmarks/{snippetSlug}.description: Stores a reference to a snippet bookmarked by the user. The document ID is the snippet slug.

/tags/{tagId}.description: Stores tags that can be associated with code snippets.

/snippets/{snippetId}/comments/{commentI.description: Stores comments for a specific code snippet.
